readerCopy.body: A conversation can stop circling once one clear sentence puts the uncomfortable subject where everyone can respond to it. When Mercury sextiles Lilith, language and refusal cooperate, making a money issue, resentment, boundary, family problem, or criticism easier to name without unnecessary escalation. Perfect wording is less important than shared information. Politeness stops helping when everybody has to keep pretending not to know the same fact.
